mission.title: Code Pulse
mission.description: Follow the Cypherite leader Cryptos' lead to capture one of E Pluribus Neo's Code Pulse Devices.

npc.say: I will admit that we have tried to obtain one of the devices on our own, but have not been successful. We might have done it, perhaps, with a certain show of force, but we are always reluctant to mount operations that might unduly disturb the citizens of this fair city.
Hold them off! I've got to upload the data!
EPN are becoming a real threat to the System. We're glad to help you get rid of them.
Good luck to you, {player}! I must say, I do admire your Machine efficiency!
We'll make a Cypherite out of you yet.

phase.briefing: The Cypherites are still attempting to win our trust, {player}. You have been invited to meet with their leader, Cryptos. He claims to have information which may be useful to us.

enter.say: I'm reading some redpill signals in there. Should be Cryptos and his bunch.

talk.say:
Ah, welcome, friend! I do indeed have some information that I think may prove of interest to you.
E Pluribus Neo has recently come up with something they call a "Code Pulse Device." Not surprisingly, it looks like a small, timed bomb. When it detonates, it sends out a pulse of customized code that permeates the locality, and sends back data to certain receivers. They seem to believe that they can use these devices to wrest specific data out of the simulation.
Whether or not these devices can do what they claim, I do not know, as they guard them very carefully. However, it occurred to me that you Machines may have the resources to capture one. I know where you can start looking. The relevant information will be uploaded to your operator.

done.say:
"Code Pulse Device"? Huh. Sounds like they could be a problem.
I'm getting a data feed now...

phase.briefing: The data Cryptos sent us includes coordinates of an EPN network terminal. Apparently, data pertaining to these "Code Pulse Devices" can be obtained there. Investigate.

enter.say: I've got some redpill signals in there; there's an active network port, too.
There's the terminal. I'm reading a data upload in progress.

done.say:
Looks like they just unloaded some data they didn't want us to find. Damn. Let's try reconstructing the network history. Hang on a sec...
Okay. Grab the data dump from the computer.
Bring that along with you. We should be able to use that data to find where they sent their precious file.

phase.briefing:
{player}, the network history you recovered from that terminal can be used to trace the destination of the file they sent just before your arrival; however, such a trace requires familiarity with certain aspects of their network configuration. We do not have this knowledge.
I have contacted Cryptos, who says that he can provide the necessary information.

enter.say: Cryptos sure is a handy guy when it comes to getting the skinny on E Pluribus Neo.

talk.say: All right. Let's hear what he's got to tell us.

done.say:
Yes, we have built up something of a familiarity with the EPN networks, friend. Let me examine this data you've procured...
Ah, indeed, this trace will lead us right to them. Why don't you take Rabbit and Yed here along with you? They'll help you steer clear of any mishaps. I'll send the routing data to your operator.
You're clear to bring those two outside. Cryptos' data feed is coming through now...

objective.text: Lead Rabbit and Yed out of the area

phase.briefing: The trace target is marked. Terminate all hostiles and search the area.

enter.say:
Somehow I get the feeling that Gray doesn't like EPNs so much...
I've got a bunch of reds in there, and an active terminal. Looks like Cryptos was on the money again.

objective.text: Get the Device from the E Pluribus Neo Crusader

done.say: That EPN has a strange piece of code on them. Haven't seen a signal quite like that before.
Oho! A suspiciously mysterious device. I think I know what that is. Get that uploaded at a hardline.
Hm, that machine's been wiped clean.
You are EPN's new worst enemy.

objective.text: Upload the Device at a hardline

mission.finish:
The program you recovered was a compiled "Code Pulse Device," {player}. A preliminary examination of its code indicates that Cryptos' assertions as to its capabilities may indeed have some basis in fact.
The Cypherites thus far have proven themselves...useful. It is time to consider ways in which we can use them more effectively.
